name: What should I do to prepare before a plumber arrives to replace an angle stop valve?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare before a plumber arrives to replace an angle stop valve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your plumber arrives to replace an angle stop valve, you should clear the area around the valve to ensure easy access. This might mean removing items from under a sink or behind a toilet. It's also helpful if you can locate your home's main water shut-off valve, as the plumber will need to turn off the water supply to the entire house temporarily. Having this information ready can streamline the service appointment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the area around the valve and locate your home's main water shut-off valve to prepare for a plumber.
